verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence spells out, before filing starts, which account, credential, or identity-proofing steps the Secretary of State's online filing requires. The only related item is a Department of Revenue line saying an account 'will also be used to file your taxes' (docs-18). That implies an account exists but does not state its creation or verification requirements, and the DOR portal probe returned only a JavaScript shell with no readable pre-login guidance.
